d: US air travel was thrown into chaos after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) experienced instability in radar and communication systems across air traffic control centres and TRACONs. During a press briefing, US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy revealed that inconsistent radar data and communication with aircraft triggered a nationwide ground stop, with more than 3,500 planes initially in the air.
